A golden melody from the unforgettable era of Hindi cinema! Listen to “Sona Lai Ja Re Chandi Lai Ja Re” from the classic Bollywood film Mera Gaon Mera Desh (1971), featuring the charming Asha Parekh and Dharmendra. Sung by the legendary Lata Mangeshkar, with music composed by the celebrated duo Laxmikant–Pyarelal, this memorable song brings the nostalgic magic of 1970s Hindi film music to life.
Sona Lai Ja Re Chandi Lai Ja Re | Mera Gaon Mera Desh | Asha Parekh, Dharmendra | Laxmikant Pyarelal
Song: Sona Lai Ja Re Chandi Lai Ja Re
Movie: Mera Gaon Mera Desh (1971)
